name: Whole Grain Mustard
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated for SIBO as it contains no significant fermentable carbohydrates and is used in small quantities.
preparationTips: Check labels for added garlic or onion powder which would increase FODMAP content
Store in refrigerator after opening to maintain flavor and texture
Mix with low-FODMAP herbs like chives or oregano for enhanced flavor
Use as a marinade base with olive oil and allowed herbs
pairsWellWith: Roasted root vegetables like carrots or parsnips
Mixed greens salad with olive oil
nutritionalHighlights: Provides small amounts of magnesium and phosphorus
